user.title: Pair your HCC100
user.description: Disconnect the Resideo Technician app from the controller. Briefly press the controller's Bluetooth button once, then select Submit to search for it.

pick.title: Select your HCC100
pick.description: More than one controller was found. Choose the one to pair.

confirm.title: Complete the handshake
confirm.description: Press the Bluetooth button on {name} again to open the connection window, then select Submit. The device certificate will be remembered for future connections.

error.not_found: No HCC100 found. Press the controller's Bluetooth button again, keep it in range, and make sure the technician app is disconnected.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Press the button again to reopen the Bluetooth window, keep the controller in range, and disconnect the technician app.
error.authentication_failed: The device identity or handshake could not be verified.
